description: This file contains implementation of context parallel attention mechanisms, including ring attention, load balancing, sharding, and related utilities for distributed training in PyTorch. It defines classes, functions, and hooks for managing attention operations across device meshes with support for different attention types and load balancing strategies.

classes.name: _ContextParallel
classes.description: Class for managing context parallel attention, supporting different attention types and hooks for distributed attention operations.

classes.name: _AttentionOp
classes.description: Protocol for attention operation functions supporting forward and backward attention computations.

classes.name: _RingRotater
classes.description: Abstract base class for ring rotation mechanisms used in distributed attention.

classes.name: _AllToAllRotater
classes.description: Implements ring rotation using all-to-all communication pattern.

classes.name: _AllGatherRotater
classes.description: Implements ring rotation using all-gather communication pattern.

classes.name: _SDPAMerger
classes.description: Helper class to merge local scaled dot product attention results across distributed ranks.

methods.name: _is_causal_behavior
methods.description: Determines the causal behavior (full, causal, skip) for a given rank and block index in distributed attention.

methods.name: _maybe_wait
methods.description: Waits on an AsyncCollectiveTensor if applicable, otherwise returns tensor directly.

methods.name: _partial_update
methods.description: Partially updates a chunk of a tensor along a specified dimension, either by addition or replacement.

methods.name: _create_rotater
methods.description: Creates a ring rotater object based on the specified rotation method.

methods.name: _templated_ring_attention
methods.description: Performs generalized ring attention supporting multiple attention operations with load balancing and causal masking.

methods.name: _templated_ring_attention_backward
methods.description: Backward pass implementation for ring attention, computing gradients across distributed ranks.

methods.name: _sdpa_handler
methods.description: Dispatches scaled dot product attention operations with sharding and load balancing, wrapping specific aten kernels.

methods.name: set_rotate_method
methods.description: Sets the rotation method ('allgather' or 'alltoall') for context parallel attention.
